Dietitians are required to complete a supervised practice expe-
rience (dietetic internship or coordinated program) before they 
can be eligible to write the exam for registration. Th is period of 
supervised practice allows the dietetic intern to gain experience
in all areas of dietetic practice. Real patients with real problems 
provide the most eﬀ ective learning experiences by stimulating
the dietetic intern’s intellectual curiosity and promoting reten-
tion of the information.
